no_adcom_quote.quote: The application does not raise significant issues regarding the safety or effectiveness of the drug; hence, no Advisory Committee Meeting was held.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the OXLUMO (lumasiran) NDA214103 approval. The Integrated Review's Advisory Committee Summary section (L547) and the FDA approval letter (L44-45) both state the application did not raise significant issues regarding safety or effectiveness, so it was not referred to an advisory committee. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
